source: The ZXNAME0000XZ model also explains why “ZXNAME0001XZ core count” is an incomplete performance model. A workload does not consume one generic pool of identical cores. Different instruction types exercise different pipelines, and modern AI kernels can depend heavily on matrix instructions, load/store throughput, shared-memory behavior, synchronization, and scheduling. The useful unit of reasoning is the whole ZXNAME0002XZ plus its memory feeds, not a single marketing count.
zh: ZXNAME0000XZ 模型还解释了为什么“ZXNAME0001XZ 核心数”是一个不完整的性能模型。工作负载不会消耗相同核心的通用池。不同的指令类型使用不同的管道，现代 AI 内核在很大程度上依赖于矩阵指令、加载/存储吞吐量、共享内存行为、同步和调度。有用的推理单位是整个 ZXNAME0002XZ 加上它的内存提要，而不是单个营销计数。
